title: Token Chargeback Composer: exportable CSV templates + interactive pricing rule preview
creator: Anika Patel
description: Design a composer UI in the Redwood Console that lets platform and finance users construct chargeback/exportable token-ledger views. The goal is a single workflow to: 1) define per-route and per-model pricing rules (flat, per-token, slab tiers), 2) preview the computed per-request line items and aggregated token-attribution, 3) simulate pricing scenarios (batch size, quantization tier, prefix caching), and 4) export a provenance-rich CSV/JSON for chargeback and accounting ingestion. The composer should integrate with rollouts (canary pricing changes) and provide templates compatible with billing pipelines.
comments: 2025-02-18 — Initial ticket created. Include two prototype directions: (A) Table-first editor (spreadsheet-like rows for routes/prompts) and (B) Canvas-based rule blocks with drag-and-drop. Objective: evaluate developer/finance workflow speed and export fidelity.

2025-02-22 — Design spike: built low-fi wireframes for both directions. Stakeholder sync with PM (Rhea Kumar) and Eng lead (Diego Morales). Engineering flagged export schema constraints (must include model_id, model_variant, sequence_length, effective_quant, cache_hits, prompt_block_id). Added those as mandatory columns for CSV exports.

2025-02-25 — Usability sessions scheduled (6 infra engineers + 4 finance PMs). Hypothesis: finance users prefer table-first, infra prefers canvas for visualizing fallback pricing rules. Decided to prototype hybrid: table as default view with optional canvas visualizer.

2025-02-28 — Prototype v0.1 (Figma): created pricing rule modal, per-route row context menu, and interactive slider to simulate batch_size/quantization. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/Redwood/chargeback-composer-v01 (internal). Note: color contrast on token attribution sparkline failed AA; updated palette.

2025-03-03 — Engineering feedback from ENG-11820: performance concern for live recalculation across >10k rows. Decision: implement server-side simulation endpoint and optimistic UI for client-side preview (we'll send compact simulation payloads). Added new dependency on ENG-11820 to implement batched simulate API.

2025-03-04 — PM review (Rhea): request to add "provenance" header fields on exports (exported_by, export_time, ruleset_id, rollout_id). Also asked for one-click template for "per-team chargeback" and a companion API doc. Added to scope.

2025-03-05 — Updated prototype v0.2: merged table + canvas. New features: rule preview tooltip that shows the mathematical breakdown, an "impact delta" column showing cost delta vs baseline, and export presets (Accounting CSV, Invoicing JSON, Data Warehouse Parquet). Uploaded updated spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CI/Token+Chargeback+Composer+Spec (internal).
